title: Retire legacy Chatticus Cognito pools and secrets
description:
Part of story chatticus-e50451 (group G4). Four legacy Cognito pools (staging x2 with 0 users, production with about 1 user and 0 users) and legacy secrets (three google oauth secrets and one invoke key in recovery windows ending about 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-25, plus two retained secrets with no deletion scheduled). After the windows, delete pools and retained secrets. Owner removes the legacy callback URLs from the Google OAuth client. Users re-link by email through Google federation, nothing to move.

Feature: Legacy auth retired
  Scenario: No legacy pool or secret remains
    Given the recovery windows have passed
    When the legacy pools and secrets are deleted
    Then sign-in in every environment still works from the Chatticus account
